I just finished this mod. My biggest issues with it are sound levels and AI. All of the custom voice acting is much quieter than everything else, making characters often hard to hear. The second thing is that on some maps in certain places, the AI of various things (usually Zombies, but Combine on occasion) is a little buggy. They will run from point A to point C to point B to get to you, instead of going A to B. Or they just get stuck on things.

The first two chapters need more polish. I noticed lots of little things, things you could get stuck on in the ground that weren't immediately noticeable, rough map -> skybox transitions, etc.

The other thing I don't quite like is that is just isn't quite Half-Life. It just seems... off... in some way. I can't describe it, it just doesn't quite feel "right."

I really like the boss battle, but it felt like it was over very quickly. It was shorter than the strider battle post- taking down the suppression device on the museum building. Maybe because all of the Combine were storming White Forest and chasing Gordon Freeman instead of attacking the protagonist in this game?

All of these things combine to make this mod feel like a beta release as far as quality. It seems like it is almost ready, it just hasn't quite been perfected.

Now, the good.

This mod's maps are very well done. I don't like everything about them, but if you told me that these were beta maps from an unreleased HL sequel Valve was developing, I would believe it. For the most part, everything is laid out in an intuitive way. It is a bit harder than HL2 and the episodes, but overall, in my opinion, better. It has much more realistic environments, that seem less "Wow, that path that takes me right were I need to go sure is nice!" and more like you are finding your way through the environment with no help. It still is a linear story, but it is a lot less hand-holding. I really liked the boss battle, combining combine with zombies with a resistance helicopter.

On a scale of 1-10, with 10 being Half-Life 2/Episodes quality, I give this game a solid 8.

Breakdown:

Map design: 9.5 out of 10. -.5 because something doesn't quite feel right, and the sprinkling of hunters everywhere. I hate hunters.

Polish: 5 out of 10. It needed polish in a lot of places, and just didn't quite feel right. (Audio levels, little map bugs, AI bugs, little things, but still took away the polished feeling of the game)

Voice acting/Facial animation of characters (not including audio levels): 9.5 out of 10. The voice acting and facial animation was done very well, my only problem was that the voices were much quieter than everything else.
